name: Apple, Mozzarella & Prosciutto Roll-Ups
instructions: Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples. Slice each apple into 8 wedges.
Cut or tear prosciutto pieces in half lengthwise into 16 strips.
Place one apple wedge and one slice of cheese at the end of each strip of prosciutto, then roll up.
To serve, divide roll-ups between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
